entities.name: Elder Dragons
entities.description: Comic based on the Elder Dragons cycle from Legends, published by Armada in 1996.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: Warlord who was manipulated into awakening Palladia-Mors and was killed.

entities.name: Ad'Amra
entities.description: Daughter of Red Donald who fell in love with Ham and helped re-sleep Palladia-Mors.

entities.name: Mors Ridge
entities.description: Town where Ham keeps Palladia-Mors at bay.

entities.name: Ham
entities.description: Boy who performs Tickery magic, secretly the Elder Dragon Chromium Rhuell.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Elder Dragon awakened by Red Donald's canal digging.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: Elder Dragon cursed into a Dragon Whelp, who manipulated Donald to free himself.

events.summary: Red Donald and Ad'Amra arrive in Mors Ridge where Ham keeps Palladia-Mors at bay.
events.quote: The warlord Red Donald and his daughter Ad'Amra arrive in the town of Mors Ridge

events.summary: Donald's digging awakens Palladia-Mors; the whelp is revealed as Vaevictis Asmadi, who had manipulated him.
Palladia lifts Vaevictis' curse and the two Elders wreak havoc, killing Red Donald.
Ham is revealed as Chromium Rhuell, who convinces Vaevictis to turn on Palladia.
events.quote: Ham is actually the benevolent Elder Dragon Chromium Rhuell

events.summary: Ad'Amra and Chromium put the sleep-spell back on Palladia.
events.quote: Finally, Ad’Amra and Chromium manage to put the sleep-spell back on Palladia.

relations.quote: the dragon whelp is revealed to be her cousin Vaevictis Asmadi
The warlord Red Donald and his daughter Ad'Amra

relations.note: she fell in love with him
relations.quote: Ad’Amra, who has fallen in love with him
